briefs.claim_en: Under the Prime Minister Free Laptop Scheme 2026, the government is providing free laptops to all students.
briefs.brief_en: Official government bodies and news reports state that the Government of India does not operate any scheme providing free laptops to students. The All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) issued an advisory on 2024-04-29 stating that claims of a 'Pradhanmantri Free Laptop Scheme' are fake. Fact-check organisations, including Vishvas News (2023-02-28, 2025-02-18) and DigitEye India (2024-01-11), documented similar recurring claims as false phishing schemes. Livemint reported on 2026-09-21 that the Press Information Bureau (PIB) Fact Check confirmed no such initiative has been announced, corroborating earlier reports by Hindustan Times on 2026-06-04 and ABP Live on 2026-08-11. Alt News previously noted related scam sites in 2019.
gaps_en: No official government record or notification establishing a 2026 national free laptop scheme found.

briefs.claim_en: The last date to apply for the Prime Minister Free Laptop Scheme 2026 is October 15.
briefs.brief_en: Available reporting indicates that deadlines associated with the purported laptop scheme are fabricated. Livemint reported on 2026-09-21 that PIB clarified that the central government has not invited applications under any free laptop scheme, debunking circulated application details. Additionally, ABP Live reported on 2026-08-11 that PIB Fact Check cautioned the public regarding fraudulent application deadlines circulating in viral social media messages. There is no verified announcement or official schedule indicating an October 15 deadline for any such central government scheme.
gaps_en: No official notification or public schedule regarding application dates found.

briefs.claim_en: Users should click on the link www.pm-free-laptop-yojana.in to register for the scheme.
briefs.brief_en: Government authorities and fact-checking organisations indicate that online registration links for a central free laptop initiative are fraudulent. AICTE warned on 2024-04-29 against deceptive registration portals circulating online. Vishvas News reported on 2023-08-30 that viral links claiming to register applicants are fraudulent clickbait. Livemint (2026-09-21) and Hindustan Times (2026-06-04) reported that PIB Fact Check identified circulating links as phishing scams designed to harvest personal and banking data. ABP Live on 2026-08-11 also reported official warnings that using these links poses risks of financial loss.
gaps_en: No official government domain registration or authentic portal found for this initiative.
